definitions: A fictional character in a popular fairy tale, typically depicted as a young woman living in unfortunate circumstances who achieves great fortune.
A person or thing that is undeservedly neglected or ignored, especially one that eventually achieves recognition or success.
A person or thing that is unexpectedly successful after a period of obscurity.
examples: The story of Cinderella is a classic tale of rags to riches.
The team was a Cinderella story, coming from last place to win the championship.
She felt like a Cinderella, always doing chores while her sisters went out.
